doc: The match camera (CamRig, scripts/match/cam.gd). styles: the Settings 'Camera' presets: pitch in degrees down from level, dist m back from the focus, fov the vertical lens in degrees on a frame_aspect screen, rise m the view aims above the focus. follow: the Settings 'Camera follow' cursor lean: [deadzone, share or maxzone, cap m, ease 1/s, quadratic easing]; the zones are the cursor's distance from the screen centre (-1..1); supervive pans 0 m, the source's view stays on you (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md 'Camera lead'). frame_aspect: width / height of that screen (16:9, the source footage's); every screen shows its width of ground, a wider one (21:9) less ahead and behind, a narrower one (4:3) more, as the source's engine keeps its horizontal lens and the source has no ultrawide view (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md 'Camera frame per aspect'). lean_edge_m: metres an aimed cast keeps between you and the screen's edge. source: the bands docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md 'Camera framing vs the source' measured from the source footage (ahead_per_behind: m of ground ahead of your feet over m behind them, side_per_ahead: m to the side at your feet over m ahead, on a frame_aspect screen); --camera-frame-check holds the supervive style inside them.
